newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway crown weakens amid selloff.
newsitem.headline: Norway crown weakens amid selloff.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- The Norwegian yield spread to German Bunds widened slightly while the crown depreciated markedly on a falling dollar, lower oil prices and foreigners selling the Norwegian currency.

"The crown's fall is a combination of the dollar and the oil prices but the most important factor is the sell pressure on the Norwegian currency," one analyst said. "Foreign investors have seen over time that the crown has not strengthened as much as they hoped it would. Now some are neutralising their positions."
The crown fell to 4.0810 against the mark at 1400 GMT compared with 4.0400 at the same time on Tuesday. The crown was quoted at 100.16 against the inverse ECU index, a basket of European currencies.
* Norway over Bunds gap two points wider at 32 points
* Three-month eurokrone three points lower at 3.48 pct
